input: scheduled: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products
task: Explore: new venture service-load-check (NEC 220.83 + 220.87 existing-service check from Green Button interval data)

doc_friction.issue: --for-changes on a new venture runs pages.yml and portfolio-pages.yml, which time out at the 300 s budget and skip the ${{ }} build step, so the downstream checks report 'no _site' failures that say nothing about the change; real CI is the only signal for those.
--only still runs journey, which fails in cloud sessions because the proxy blocks the workers.dev /hit endpoint (ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED), not because of the venture.

notes: Idea: service-load-check. Can an existing home service take an EV charger / heat pump / induction range? It runs NEC 220.83 from an appliance list and NEC 220.87 from a year of the utility's Green Button 15-minute data (CSV in several layouts, plus ESPI XML). 5-minute readings go into clock-aligned blocks. Hourly data, short records, gaps and solar each get a flag. It shows the largest charger setting each method allows. Marketing guide with a worked example; a test checks every figure in it against the engine. Checks: node --test 26/26 pass. browser_checks.py --only service-load-check: sideways, presets, roundtrip, optout, sweep ok; highlight and contrast skipped (no dependency); journey failed on proxy-blocked workers.dev only. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: venture and page checks ran; pages.yml and portfolio-pages.yml steps failed on the harness (300 s budget, build step not evaluated), so I relied on real CI. Code factors are as I read the 2017-2023 NEC, not checked against a licensed copy (README says so). Next: model a load-managed charger against the interval data, and an inspector-format worksheet as a paid contractor path. CI: three red rounds before green. All were real wiring gaps for a new venture, now fixed: (1) no launch date (launched.mjs --write); the opt-out count pinned at 1301 (now 1302); the hub catch-all over its bound (filed under trades); a crawlable orphan (one-hop links added from electrical-panel-upgrade-bid-calculator and ev-charger-bid-calculator, with tests); FAQ JSON-LD not matching the visible text (regenerated from the page). (2) The trades sub-group rule (trades-mep). (3) An unguarded KINDS[l.kind] lookup, now Object.hasOwn, with a test. Local platform/pages suite: 1515/1515 pass.
